claims.text: The United States moved to force TikTok’s divestiture or ban due to national security concerns, specifically the risk of Chinese government access to US user data and its recommendation algorithm [Source: ev-1].

This concern was formalized in legislation signed by President Biden on 2024-04-24, which required ByteDance to divest TikTok's US operations within roughly 270 days (extendable by an additional 90 days) or face a ban [Source: ev-1].
The Supreme Court upheld this law with a unanimous 9-0 decision on 2025-01-17, one day before the effective date of 2025-0-19 [Source: ev-1].
